subject: design/ecosystem-help-v1
statement: `/help` is a **prompt-walk skill**: at invocation, the session reads the live routing surfaces raw — the shipped pipeline map whole, plus every installed skill's frontmatter description — and composes its three answers (catalog, route, first steps) in-session, holding no per-capability content of its own and shipping no new binary, verb, or generated artifact. The first-steps path is the same skill's `start` argument; the installer's welcome work item carries the literal string `/help start`. (design-brainstorm:ecosystem-help-tech-design#D-1, #D-2)
